description.text: Why choose to study this program? The joint MBA program between NBU and UC was started in 2001 upon the approval of the Ministry of Education of China. It is the only Chinese-foreign joint MBA program in Zhejiang Province, China. The program aims to train senior managerial professionals equipped with sound business management knowledge and capabilities as well as an international vision and pioneering spirit. Up to now, several hundreds of advanced managerial professionals have graduated from this program and been well recognized in the local society. NBU-UC MBA is a thriving and competitive brand in China. Main Courses Term Year Unit Delivery University Term 1 Sep-Jan 1 Accounting for Managers Ningbo University Economics for Managers University of Canberra Marketing Ningbo University Term 2 Feb-Jun 1 Human Resource Management Ningbo University Organizational Behavior University of Canberra Business Finance Ningbo University Term 1 Sep-Jan 2 International Business University of Canberra International Trade Law Ningbo University Statistical Analysis & Decision Making University of Canberra Term 2 Feb-Jun 2 Management Ethics Management Communication University of Canberra Ningbo University Strategic Management University of Canberra 6 units of NBU are delivered on week days; 6 units of UC are of intensive teaching (one week per unit for class attending) Fees Tuition: RMB 90,000 totally Textbook & teaching material: about RMB 2,500 totally UC English Language Test: feeto be finalized Internship and Career Development Graduates can take the management jobs in investment company, securities agency, banks, consultant firm, marketing etc. They are rather popular in Ningbo local companies. Diploma Awarded UC MBA degree Note: Only Bachelor degree holders are eligible to apply for NBU degree and required to complete 4 more courses besides the above 12. UC MBA Degree 1. Students of non-English speaking countries meeting both of the following requirements can obtain the normal (standard) UC MBA degree, which is the same as that delivered on UC Australian campus: (a) Achieve a result of IELTS 6.0 at least, or pass the UC English Language Test (3 chances at most) before the start of the second year. (b) Successfully complete all the units of the MBA. 2. Students who do not satisfy the requirement for English proficiency but pass all the units, shall be awarded the UC MBA degree with an extra sentence on it- “Taught in English and Chinese”. Academic Semesters Students in this program will spend 2 years in Ningbo university, while each year is divided into 2 semesters. First semester: from Sep to Jan, Second semester: from Feb to Jun.

duration.text: The Sino-Australia Joint NBA Program at Ningbo University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6250 USD/per year ￥ 45000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7.Proof of work experience (if applicable)

requirements.text: Bachelor degree holders with a minimum of 2-year work experience. Diploma holders with a minimum of 4-year work experience. Sufficient English level Bachelor degree holders without work experience are enrolled as GDBA students (Graduate Diploma in Business Administration) and would then be eligible to enroll in the MBA on successful completion of the GDBA.
